_note: All patients, reports and model outputs are synthetic, written for the demo. mock_model_output stands in for CV model probabilities until real images/models are wired in. | report_delay: scan is acquired first (report pending, reading queue) and signed on the next demo step. outside_records: priors from another hospital, imported as history. followup: arrives on the booked appointment day.

scan.report_text: Frontal and lateral chest radiograph. There is a 3.2 cm mass in the left hilum. No pneumothorax. No pleural effusion. Heart size is normal. Recommend CT chest with contrast.
scan.image_credit: NIH ChestX-ray14 (public), via TorchXRayVision test images

scan.report_text: MRI brain with and without contrast. There are three ring-enhancing lesions in the left frontal lobe and right parietal lobe with surrounding edema. No midline shift. Findings are concerning for metastatic disease.
scan.indication: Staging: new headaches, known lung mass

scan.report_text: CT abdomen and pelvis without contrast for flank pain. A 5 mm obstructing stone is seen in the left ureter, consistent with kidney stone. Incidental note is made of a 7 mm nodule in the right lower lobe. Recommend follow-up chest CT.
scan.indication: ER: left flank pain, rule out kidney stone

scan.report_text: Portable chest radiograph. Large left pneumothorax. No pleural effusion.
scan.indication: ER: sudden chest pain and shortness of breath after a fall, rule out pneumothorax
scan.image_credit: Wikimedia Commons 'Pneumothorax CXR.jpg' by Clinical Cases, CC BY-SA 2.5

scan.report_text: Chest radiograph. Enlarged cardiac silhouette consistent with cardiomegaly. Lungs are clear. No pneumothorax.
scan.indication: Outpatient: shortness of breath on exertion
scan.image_credit: NIH ChestX-ray14 (public), via TorchXRayVision test images

scan.report_text: MRI brain for headaches. There is a 9 mm extra-axial mass along the right frontal convexity, most consistent with meningioma. No edema. No midline shift.

scan.indication: Follow-up: growing right lower lobe nodule
scan.report_text: CT chest without contrast. The 7 mm nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged in size. No new nodules.
CT chest without contrast. Incidental note is made of a 4 mm nodule in the right lower lobe. No routine follow-up recommended for a low-risk patient. Lungs otherwise clear.
